run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point energy and gradient calculation using ORCA with a specified XC functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization using ORCA with configurable optimizer parameters and step counter start index
run_orca_calculation_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled via the nbo flag
run_orca_metal_organics_calculation: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using the Vertical.MetalOrganics setting
run_parallel_orca_calculation: run an ORCA single-point or optimization calculation parallelized across multiple CPU cores using the nprocs parameter
